🔁M ✦⁺ (462) 🗓1d 👁️11K
i’ve been working on field atlas, an android app for asking questions using a model and knowledge saved on your phone. once you’ve set it up, the research part works without an internet connection.
the current version is v1.2.0-rc.1. you can install a model, add optional knowledge collections, and ask questions about what you’ve saved. there are collections for biology and travel, or you can import a compatible collection of your own.
this update also lets you attach a photo or file to extract text from it. that’s useful for things like a sign, a menu, or a document when you’re travelling. answers can link back to saved source passages so you can read them yourself.
it’s still a prerelease. the model can get things wrong, the collections don’t cover everything, and saved travel information may be out of date. please check important answers against the sources.
you can try it at https://www.getfieldatlas.com/. it currently needs an android 13+ arm64 phone, and the model and knowledge... Show more
